verses.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
lines: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever.
With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

verses.text: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
lines: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever.
You established the heavens.
Your faithfulness is in them.”

verses.text: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
lines: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one,
I have sworn to David, my servant,

verses.text: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’ ”
lines: ‘I will establish your offspring forever,
and build up your throne to all generations.’ ”

verses.text: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
lines: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh,
your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.text: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
lines: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh?
Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

verses.text: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
lines: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones,
to be feared above all those who are around him?

verses.text: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
lines: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you?
Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

verses.text: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
lines: You rule the pride of the sea.
When its waves rise up, you calm them.

verses.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
lines: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain.
You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

verses.text: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
lines: The heavens are yours.
The earth also is yours,
the world and its fullness.
You have founded them.

verses.text: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
lines: You have created the north and the south.
Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

verses.text: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
lines: You have a mighty arm.
Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

verses.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
lines: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne.
Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

verses.text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
lines: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you.
They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

verses.text: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
lines: In your name they rejoice all day.
In your righteousness, they are exalted.

verses.text: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
lines: For you are the glory of their strength.
In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

verses.text: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.
lines: For our shield belongs to Yahweh,
our king to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
lines: Then you spoke in vision to your saints,
and said, “I have given strength to the warrior.
I have exalted a young man from the people.

verses.text: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
lines: I have found David, my servant.
I have anointed him with my holy oil,

verses.text: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
lines: with whom my hand shall be established.
My arm will also strengthen him.

verses.text: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
lines: No enemy will tax him.
No wicked man will oppress him.

verses.text: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
lines: I will beat down his adversaries before him,
and strike those who hate him.

verses.text: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
lines: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him.
In my name, his horn will be exalted.

verses.text: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
lines: I will set his hand also on the sea,
and his right hand on the rivers.

verses.text: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
lines: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father,
my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

verses.text: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
lines: I will also appoint him my firstborn,
the highest of the kings of the earth.

verses.text: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
lines: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more.
My covenant will stand firm with him.

verses.text: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
lines: I will also make his offspring endure forever,
and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.text: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
lines: If his children forsake my law,
and don’t walk in my ordinances;

verses.text: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
lines: if they break my statutes,
and don’t keep my commandments;

verses.text: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
lines: then I will punish their sin with the rod,
and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
lines: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him,
nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

verses.text: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
lines: I will not break my covenant,
nor alter what my lips have uttered.

verses.text: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
lines: Once I have sworn by my holiness,
I will not lie to David.

verses.text: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
lines: His offspring will endure forever,
his throne like the sun before me.

verses.text: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
lines: It will be established forever like the moon,
the faithful witness in the sky.”

verses.text: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
lines: But you have rejected and spurned.
You have been angry with your anointed.

verses.text: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
lines: You have renounced the covenant of your servant.
You have defiled his crown in the dust.

verses.text: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
lines: You have broken down all his hedges.
You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

verses.text: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
lines: All who pass by the way rob him.
He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

verses.text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
lines: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries.
You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

verses.text: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
lines: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword,
and haven’t supported him in battle.

verses.text: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
lines: You have ended his splendor,
and thrown his throne down to the ground.

verses.text: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.
lines: You have shortened the days of his youth.
You have covered him with shame.

verses.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
lines: How long, Yahweh?
Will you hide yourself forever?
Will your wrath burn like fire?

verses.text: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
lines: Remember how short my time is,
for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

verses.text: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
lines: What man is he who shall live and not see death,
who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?

verses.text: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
lines: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses,
which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

verses.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
lines: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants,
how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

verses.text: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
lines: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh,
with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

verses.text: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
lines: Blessed be Yahweh forever more.
Amen, and Amen.
